items.text: Amadodana ka-Isakare: ngoThola, noPhuwa, noJashubi, noShimroni, bebane.

Amadodana kaThola: nguShela; o-Uzi, noRefaya, noJeriyeli, noJagimayi, noJibisamu, noSemuweli, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, bengabakaThola; babengamaqhawe anesibindi ezizukulwaneni zabo; inani labo ngemihla kaDavide laliyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili namakhulu ayisithupha.
Amadodana ka-Uzi; noJisrágja: amadodana kaJisrágja; uMikayeli, no-Obhadja, noJoweli, noJisiya, bebahlanu, beyizikhulu zonke.
Kanye nabo, ngokwemizalwane yabo, ngokwezindlu zoyise, kwakukhona amaviyo empi, amadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nesithupha, ngokuba babe nabafazi abaningi namadodana amaningi.
Abafowabo, ezizukulwaneni zonke zika-Isakare, babengamaqhawe anamandla, beyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisishiyagalombili nesikhombisa bebonke.
Amadodana kaBenjamini; uBhela, noBekeri, noJediyayeli, bebathathu.

Amadodana kaBela ngu u-Esboni, no-Uzi, no-Uziyeli, noJerimoti, no-Iri, beyisihlanu; izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, amaqhawe anamandla; futhi ngokwemilibo yabo yokuzalwa babe yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili namashumi amathathu nane.
Amadodana kaBeri: uSemira, noJowashi, no-Eliyezeri, no-Elijonayi, no-Omri, noJerimoti, no-Abiya, no-Anathoti, no-Alameti. Bonke bangamadodana kaBhegeri.
Inani labo ngokwezizukulwane zabo ngezizukulwane zabo, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, amaqhawe anamandla, babe yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili namakhulu amabili.
Lamadodana kaJediyayeli: UBhilihani namadodana kaBilihani; oJewusi, noBenjamini, no-Ehudi, noKhanani, noSethani, noTharishishi, no-Ahisahari.
Wonke lawa amadodana kaJediyayeli ngezinhloko zawoyise, amaqhawe anamandla, ayeyizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesikhombisa namakhulu amabili angaphuma impi ukuya empini.
NoSupimi noHupimi, amadodana ka-Iri, noHusimu, amadodana ka-Aheri.
Amadodana kaNafetali; uJagiyeli, noGuni, noJezeri, noShalumi, amadodana kaBiliha.
Oonyana bakaManase ngu u-Asiriyeli amzalayo; kepha isancinza sakhe, umAramu, sazala uMagire, uyise kaGileyadi.
UMagiri wayesethatha udadewabo kaHuphimi noSupimi, udadewabo ogama lakhe linguMaga, waba ngumkakhe; igama leyesibili lalinguSelofehadi; uSelofehadi wayenamadodakazi.
UMahaga umkaMagiri wazala indodana, wayiqamba igama lokuthi uPheresi; igama lomfowabo lalinguSeresi; amadodana akhe kwakungu-Ulamu noRakemi.
Amadodana ka-Ulamu: Phenduka. Laba babengamadodana kaGileyadi indodana kaMagiri indodana kaManase.
Udadewabo uHamolekete wazala uJesudi, no-Abiyezeri, noMahala.
Amadodana kaSemida kwakungu-Ahyan, noShekemi, noLiki, no-Anjamu.
Amadodana ka-Efrayimi; noSutela, noBeredi indodana yakhe, noThahati indodana yakhe, no-Elada indodana yakhe, noThahati indodana yakhe.
NoZabadi indodana yakhe, noSutela indodana yakhe, no-Ezeri, no-Eleyadi ababulala abantu baseGati ababezalelwe kulelo zwe, ngokuba behla ukuzothatha izinkomo zabo.
Uyise u-Efrayimi walila izinsuku eziningi, abafowabo beza ukumduduza.
Esengenile kumkakhe, wakhulelwa, wazala indodana, wayiqamba igama lokuthi uBeriya, ngokuba izinto zazingahambi kahle endlini yakhe.
Indodakazi yakhe kwakunguSera, owakha iBheti Horoni Ezansi nelaseNhla ne-Usesera.
URefa wayeyindodana yakhe, noRezefi, noThela indodana yakhe, noThahani indodana yakhe,
indodana yakhe uLadani, indodana yakhe u-Amihudi, indodana yakhe uElisama,
Hhayi indodana yakhe, uJoshuwa indodana yakhe.
Imfuyo yabo nezindawo zabo zokuhlala kwakuyiBethele namadlelo ayo, neNaharani nentshonalanga yeGezeri namazanyana ayo; neShekemi namadlelo alo, kwaze kwaba seGaza namadlelo alo;

Eceleni komkhawulo wabantwana bakwaManase: iBeti Sheyani namazanyana ayo, neThahanaki namazanyana ayo, neMegido namazanyana ayo, neDori namazanyana ayo. Kulokhu kwahlala abantwana bakwaJosefa, indodana ka-Israyeli.
Amadodana ka-Asheri: oImna, noJeshuwa, noJishuwa, noBeriya, noSeraki, udadewabo.
Amadodana kaBeriya ngu uHebhere noMalikiyeli onguyise kaBhirsaviti.
UHebhere wazala uJaflethi, noSomeri, noHotam, noShuwa udadewabo.
Amadodana kaJafeleti ngu IPhasika kanye neBimhal kanye ne-Ashwat. Lawa angamadodana kaJaflethi.
Amadodana kaShameri: u-Ahi noRoga, uJehuba no-Aramu.
Amadodana omfowabo uHelemu ngu Osofa noJimna noSeles no-Amal.
Amadodana kaSofa: USuag noHarnefer noSual noBeri noImra,
uBetsere, noHodi, noShama, noSilisa, noJitran, noBeera.
Amadodana kaJetheri: UJefunne noPispa no-Ara.
Amadodana ka-Ula: U-Arag noHaniel noResia.

Bonke babengabantwana baka-Asheri, izinhloko zezindlu zoyise, amaqhawe akhethiweyo, anamandla, izinhloko zezikhulu. Ababhalwe ohlwini lozalo lwamadoda aphuma umkhosi ayengamadoda ayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nesithupha.
